items.title: Transpacific ocean rates ease off July's historic highs
items.summary: Space to the U.S. West Coast has improved after carriers added deployments, though East and Gulf Coast capacity stays tight. Panama Canal restrictions and South China weather disruptions continue to weigh on cost and schedule reliability.

items.title: Taiwan and Korea air lanes stay squeezed by AI hardware demand
items.summary: Semiconductor and AI-server exports are absorbing available transpacific air capacity, pushing DHL Global Forwarding to recommend booking Taiwan and Korea origin shipments two to three weeks ahead. South China routings currently offer more pricing stability.

items.title: US container imports climb again in July
items.summary: Descartes data shows U.S. container imports rose roughly 4.5% in July, with China-origin volumes hitting new highs as retailers front-load ahead of anticipated tariff increases.

items.title: Typhoon Dolphin adds to East Asia port congestion
items.summary: The storm's landfall near Ningbo has compounded existing congestion across East Asian ports, with knock-on effects expected for transpacific sailing schedules in the coming weeks.

items.title: New US country-specific tariff regime takes effect
items.summary: A revised tariff structure introduced July 24 applies duties of 10% and 12.5% across roughly 60 trading partners, reshaping routing and sourcing decisions for shippers and forwarders alike.

items.title: FedEx divests supply chain services unit to CMA CGM
items.summary: FedEx is selling its supply chain services division to CMA CGM, which plans to fold the business into its Ceva Logistics subsidiary — a signal of continued consolidation between ocean carriers and contract logistics providers.

items.title: DHL lifts 2026 guidance on logistics demand
items.summary: DHL has raised its full-year 2026 guidance, citing resilient logistics demand and stronger-than-expected second-quarter results across its forwarding and supply chain units.

items.title: Yusen Logistics deploys AI-powered air freight platform with cargo.one
items.summary: Yusen Logistics is rolling out cargo.one's AI-driven operating system to handle air freight sales and procurement, part of a broader forwarder push toward automated rate sourcing and booking.

items.title: Forwarders move from AI pilots to production
items.summary: Major players including CH Robinson and Kuehne+Nagel are moving AI agents out of pilot phase and into live operations, with industry commentary framing this as the biggest structural shift in forwarding workflows in years — though fragmented legacy systems remain a drag on adoption.

items.title: C.H. Robinson: air and ocean markets are decoupling by region
items.summary: C.H. Robinson's August outlook describes air freight demand as increasingly localized — AI-related exports lifting select Asian origins while Europe softens — even as ocean freight sees broadly easing demand and improving space on several lanes.
